[[File:Tingel_Arm.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Tingel Arm of the galaxy]]
The '''Tingel Arm''' was a spiral arm of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], extending from the inner portion of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] to its [[Galactic Rim/Legends|edge]]. 

==History==
Before the onset of the [[Great Galactic War]], the reformed and rebuilt [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] began to make its opening moves against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They first began a period of covert operations and seeded the planets of [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]], [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] and [[Ruuria/Legends|Ruuria]] with puppet governments that showed loyalty to the Republic but were truly subjects of the Sith Empire. It was during this stage that [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Sith battlecruisers]] were first sighted on the Tingel Arm with the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]] subjugated though the Republic were unaware of who these intruders were at the time. During a diplomatic mission sent to the unknown fleet, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] struck and destroyed the envoy's vessel. When the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] rallied to attack this foe, they found their forces trapped in Sith territory as the infiltrated planets showed their true nature thus allowing the Republic forces to be devastated. In the aftermath, only a few number of ships managed to escape from the Sith and had been forced to scatter thus weakening the Republic's grasp over their territory as well as encouraging the Sith Empire to continue its onslaught. 

A year following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong Invasion]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] annually sent reconnaissance vessels out to the Tingel Arm in order to check that there were no lingering [[Yuuzhan Vong]] operating in the area.<ref name="LF1">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that the Tingel Arm was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was a geographic feature bigger than a [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
